shared_elements: two-wheeled vehicle / cart shown in profile
framing bands and borders around the main image
small geometric motifs enclosed in square panels
justification:
The clearest correspondence is that both surfaces depict a two-wheeled vehicle seen in profile, with the wheels as circles flanking a boxy body, and both frame their imagery with borders containing repeated small geometric motifs. Against that, B shows a full narrative scene 
with a draught animal, a driver, and registers of processing standing figures beneath a crenellated cornice, while A is a single, isolated, purely linear schematic vehicle with no figures at all, and the manner of depiction (thin incised outline vs. modelled naturalistic relief) is entirely different.
